note: SNG-342. Aevi: 'today reference doc and forgotten wiring are indistinguishable from outside.' Every rules file registered in the manifest that no loader fetches is listed HERE with a reason, or the build fails. This file is deliberately NOT registered in provides.rules — it is a statement about content, not content. Sits beside rules/ rather than inside it so directory sweeps of the rules corpus do not treat it as a rule.

kind_vocabulary._note: ⛔ SNG-344. `kind` IS NOT A LABEL. The old orphan gate skipped any file whose kind wasn't 'rules', so authoring an accurate descriptive word — `emergence`, `world_structure`, `social_mechanic_spec` — silently removed that file from the check. Aevi: 'a field I treated as a label was load-bearing for a gate, and my accuracy in naming a thing is exactly what removed it from the check… IN A CONTENT-DRIVEN ENGINE THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS A PURELY DESCRIPTIVE FIELD.' The vocabulary is now CLOSED: a new value fails the build, so inventing a word can never again be a silent behaviour change. Adding one is a two-line edit here — the cost is a sentence, not a ticket.
kind_vocabulary.rules: Operational. The engine loads it and behaves differently because of it.
kind_vocabulary.content: Authored world material the engine reads (locations, people, items).
kind_vocabulary.world_structure: Structural canon about how the world is arranged.
kind_vocabulary.design_canon: Decisions and principles for humans. Never engine-read.
kind_vocabulary.design_audit: Findings about the corpus. Never engine-read.
kind_vocabulary.gm_guidance_doc: Guidance folded into the GM prompt.
kind_vocabulary.progression_rules: Level/rank progression tables the engine reads (the sub-attribute ladder).
kind_vocabulary.migration: A one-time id remap recorded for a content migration — old id → what it became. ⚠️ A RECORD, NOT A RUNTIME PATH: nothing loads it, and it must not be applied to saves without an audit first, because a migration that was later REVERSED leaves rows that rewrite a live craft into one that does not exist. See the CCODE-231 gate: 32 of `ability_rename_map`'s 408 rows are exactly that today.

runtime_unwired._note: Operational content with no consumer. These are REAL GAPS, not decisions. Listed so they are visible rather than silent; each needs a consumer that WANTS it (Aevi: 'a file wired without a consumer is the same failure with more steps'), so none is wired here.
runtime_unwired.combination_recipes: ⛔ SNG-344 RESOLVED — 'which is canon' had no answer as asked: NEITHER, because they are not duplicates. THE PAIR IS CANON. world/braid_recipes.json (7, loaded) is the NAMING authority: order_sense+palework → 'Ashen Meridian', with no mechanics at all. This file (56, dark) is the MECHANICAL authority: effect, cannot, functions, domains, discovery. One names, the other resolves — so the live system can tell a player their braid is called Shatterlight and cannot tell them what it does. Stays unwired only until Aevi's crosswalk lands; the join is authored content, not an engine merge.

reference_pending_build._note: Design specs for work not yet built. Each carries a buildImplication section — the author's own statement that code should follow. Unloaded is CORRECT today; the debt is the unbuilt feature, not the missing wiring.
reference_pending_build.cross_axis_modifiers: Erik's 2026-07-07 correction on how the two thin Reaches (emotional_logical, falsehood_truth, demonic_angelic) modify across axes. Its buildImplication describes a modifier system that does not exist yet. Spec first, wiring after.
reference_pending_build.pole_signatures: Explicitly 'the content-and-resolution layer SNG-027 leans on but left undefined'. It is the missing half of the social contest, written down so it stops being lost. Wire it when social contest is built.

reference_permanent._note: Design canon and audits. These are for humans — Aevi authoring, Erik deciding. They will never have an engine consumer and should not be counted as debt.
reference_permanent.peoples_of_kind: SNG-089 canon: which traditions do not resonate with human civilization. Shapes what Aevi authors; the engine reads the resulting content, never this rationale.
reference_permanent.gambit_design: RECOVERED canon (2026-07-12) — the gambit definition lost when it lived only in a spec file. Its gmRules are authoring guidance for how Aevi writes gambits, not a runtime table.
reference_permanent.challenge_design: RECOVERED canon (2026-07-12) — the SNG-049 correction, principle, and modes. Guidance for authoring challenges. Deliberately kept as content so it cannot be lost again the way the original spec was.
reference_permanent.skill_utility_audit: Erik's meta-critique: in D&D a spell's use is obvious, many of ours are not. An AUDIT — coverageFindings and novelUses are findings about the corpus, not data the engine reads.

wired_elsewhere._note: Registered, not fetched by the loader, but genuinely consumed — the consumer is a CI check rather than engine code. Not orphans.
wired_elsewhere.resolution: Fetched via rulePath("resolution") + fetchJSON rather than loadRule — a real load through a different door.
wired_elsewhere.emergence_recipes: Fetched as loadRule("emergence") — the file name and the rule name differ, which is exactly how the SNG-331 resolver regression hid.
wired_elsewhere.martial_paths: SNG-345: WIRED. engine/martial.js reads baselineDefense + formKits; loaded via loadRule("martial_paths") into rules.martialPaths, projected into the ability catalog, granted at creation and by reconcile step 27. Was a REAL GAP for a month with its own engineNote naming the implementation.
wired_elsewhere.sub_attribute_ladder: SNG-356: WIRED. loadRule("sub_attribute_ladder") -> rules.subAttributeLadder; resolve.js pays the authored rollCumulative column in place of the retired attributeSoftCap formula; engine/ladder.js pays the pool grants against a high-water mark, from BOTH doors (spendSubPoint in play, reconcile step 29 retroactively). Shipped on SNG-357 harness evidence per Aevi gating the roll column on it.

_moved.power_sources: SNG-382 — promoted out of `wired_elsewhere` on 2026-08-08. It was honestly classified while its only consumer was a CI audit, and that was true when written. SNG-172 §4 has since been executed: 26 weighted source mixes authored with Erik's reasons. A file that describes how power works cannot reach only a test, so it is now fetched by `loadRule("power_sources")` and read by `craftSource()` as the fallback for a craft whose tradition the character has no school in. ⚠️ IT ANSWERS FOR NOTHING YET — the five school-less traditions (harmonic, radiant_folk, valley_craft, precursor, cross_pole_braid, 53 crafts) have no mix either. The reader ships first so the content can land without code.
